observations: Photo 0: Front view of a silver HP laptop with screen on, showing Windows 10/11 desktop. Keyboard is black with silver frame. 'EliteBook' logo visible on palm rest. Intel sticker on lower right. Screen bezel has 'hp' logo. Watermark 'STAND TALL GADGETS STORES' across screen.
Photo 1: Same front view, screen now shows blue Windows wallpaper. Keyboard and trackpad unchanged. Intel sticker visible. Watermark present.
Photo 2: Closed laptop, silver lid with circular HP logo. Hand holding it. Background shows shelves with other gadgets. Watermark present.

claims.evidence: Seller's words and 'EliteBook' logo on palm rest in photo 0, HP logo on lid in photo 2.
Intel sticker visible in photo 0 and 1, but no model number or generation visible. Cannot confirm if it's 6th gen Core i7.
No system information visible on screen. Cannot verify RAM from photos alone.
No disk information visible. Cannot verify storage type or size from photos.
Keyboard is lit in photos, but no toggle or indicator visible to confirm backlit feature. Could be ambient light.
No CPU model visible. Intel sticker present but no text readable. Cannot confirm generation.
Laptop appears to be 14-inch form factor, consistent with HP EliteBook 840 G3. Screen bezel and overall size match typical 14-inch model.

risks.risk: RAM is not 8GB or is faulty
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information showing RAM size and health.
risks.if_unproven: priced as 4GB or lower, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Storage is not 256GB SSD or is failing
risks.proof: Screenshot of disk management or system information showing storage type and size.
risks.if_unproven: priced as HDD or smaller SSD, which reduces value.

risks.risk: CPU is not 6th gen Core i7 or is damaged
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information showing CPU model and health.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-end CPU, which reduces value.

risks.proof: Video or photo showing keyboard lighting toggled on/off in dark environment.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-backlit keyboard, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Laptop has physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges, hinges, screen bezel, and underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having moderate wear, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Screenshot of system information showing CPU, RAM, and storage details.
Video or photo showing keyboard backlight in dark environment.
Close-up photos of all edges, hinges, screen bezel, and underside.
Photo of the laptop's serial number or service tag.
response.reason: While the model is identifiable as HP EliteBook 840 G3, key specifications like RAM, SSD, CPU generation, and keyboard backlight cannot be verified from photos alone. These are critical to pricing. Hidden risks like physical damage or faulty components also need verification before pricing.
